text: Well done, you sheep kissing, diseased son of a goblin loving mother.  Well done indeed.
I hope you have no children, for they are soon to be orphans.
I didn't think it would happen like this.
I swear, if you make my cake drop......!
You will pay for your mistake by dying!
makes one last click and then collapses to the ground.
shrivels up and falls to the ground dead.
Foolish small-mind!  You will long rue the day you met our kind.
One portion, one portion in four!  I shall drink your soul, and wish for more!
I will wash my hands of your blood when I am done!
becomes still, then drops to the ground abruptly leaving a lifeless pile of stones.
Your soul shall be mine, air breather!
strikes at you in a flurry of blackened blood and bile.
How...did...ugh...
glows with power as it prepares its attack!
drips black fluid from its eyes and mouth.
Come and feel the blade of the Dark Bargainers.
You will not live to regret that!
There is no shame in falling to a foe of the master!
Challenging an elite warrior is unwise!
slurs some insults before it falls to the ground.
This should not take long. You have no chance against me.
A massive figure of flowing robes turns toward you and begins to give chase.
dissolves into a pile of black sand.
materialized out of the darkness
quivers and then melts silently into the dark marble.
Stand where you are, scum!!
I shall show you the pure fury of the Dead!!
falls from the air, lifeless.
lunges towards you, clawing at your throat.
moves into action, its fist of rotten mail descending toward your head to knock you senseless.
spins in small circles as it drifts to the ground.
tries to squirm away, then falls still.
strikes at you with its feeder.
oozes a clear liquid as it stops clicking and falls still.
takes a bite at you with its last breath.
GoonjabagoodjabagoonjabaGahhhhh!
No, this isn't possible, how could I fail?
You have tread onto sacred ground!
Next time I will prove myself worthy to Paffa.
falls over into a smelly heap
slams against the ground as it attempts a final swing!
sounds eerily human as it releases its final shriek!
emits a chattering sound and moves toward you!
bursts from its injured areas and begins to dissolve.
stumbles, falling lifelessly to the ground, its wings tattered and torn from the long battle.
roars loudly and charges.
lets out an ear piercing howl, as it falls to its side, mortally wounded.
For the honor of Alto Bellumon!
Protect the goods!
reveals its fangs.
drops to the ground making a crackling noise.
uproots and heads right for you!
scurries towards you, angrily screeching at you.
I have finally met my match. To the winds I return. . .
You dare to defile our treetop sanctuary and expect to live?
sizzles as the static field surrounding it fades.
I see invaders prepare to attack!
You have bested me in combat but this is far from the end.
submits to the multiple attacks upon it and falls to the ground battered and beaten.
Run!!  Leave this place at once!!
gnashes is its huge pointy fangs together as it moves to claim another as its victim.
is enveloped in a swirling force of elements and then begins to move towards you.
succumbs to the numerous blows it has taken and slumps to the ground.
growls ferociously with its teeth bared.
My brethren of the Scaleguard will avenge me!
stares lifelessly as black blood oozes from its eyes.
My comrades will avenge my death.
charges toward you on its knuckles.
swings at you with its calloused fist.
continues to try to fight, not realizing that it is dead.
weapon snaps in its hands as it falls to the ground.
laughs in pleasure as it collapses.
gasps for life as its mind loses its sharpness.
topples over to rest forever on the uninviting ground.
yelps harrowingly before stumbling to the ground.
roars violently toward the sky at the broken victim.
can no longer serve its destructive masters.
crumbles to the ground in a heap of rubble.
lifelessly crumples to the ground.
No!  It must..not..end..like this!
grunts viciously as it prepares to attack!
collapses under his own weight before releasing his last breath.
blinks, pausing for a moment, then moves forward with determination into battle.
whimpers, her body going limp as she tips over.
You hear an earsplitting skittering as the spider approaches to find its next meal.
My word!! I cannot believe how cold it is out here. I must keep running around just to keep warm.
Great Tribunal, help me to smite this foe!!
Halt in the name of Antonius Bayle! Fleeing will only make me angry and your beating more severe!
senses your presence and ventures closer, the many mouths nipping at the air.
You stand to gain no honor in my death. May the wrath of Rallos Zek strike you down with great vengeance.
topples over, the stones grinding out a sound, 'Teeeeerlok.'
Mortals? Here? You will be destroyed for your curiosity and carelessness!
charges with a thunderous battle roar.
How are you. bub?  Enjoy the drinks. but watch your gold.  There are rogues everywhere.
Yekan the Weaver materializes before you. It seems to make a quick appraisal of you before fading from your sight.
roars, as wind rushes through the area.

stumbles as black blood floods from the wound at her side.  She crumples, but continues to twitch and jerk, causing spatters of her own black blood to smear across the floor.  You gaze, horrified, at her gaping wound and realize there is a sword hilt lodged inside of her still warm corpse.  For a moment you think the hilt is moving, but then struggle to keep from retching as you realize the body is filled with maggots.
crackles into a cloud of radiant energy as its energy dissipates.
pats its rumbling belly as it bounces toward its next meal.
How dare you take up arms against me!
smiles wickedly. 'Good, I was getting bored.'
Bertoxxulous awaits you, and I shall again, for I will be twisted anew to curse you to death!
My death only gives Lord Bertoxxulous strength; it is a pleasure to serve him so!
'Enemies are afoot. Charge!'
hisses in pain and dies.
pitches forward, its scales glistening with blood.
raises its wings and hisses.
reaches for its quiver and readies for battle.
moves toward you with great hostility, a foreboding sense of impending doom prevalent from the noxious fumes emanating from him.
's corpse sinks back into the earth.
Aiyiyiyiyiyiyi!
whirls ahead in a squall of stinging sand.
'Fools!  You will soon see the futility of your arrogance!'
I've spent many a year on the seas of Norrath, friend. As much as I've seen, I've never seen a ship greater than the Queen of Thorns.
The crew shaped up nicely. I have faith that they will keep the Queen of Thorns in good stead.
Can ye smell that fresh sea air? Marvelous, ain't it?
The bone pile crumbles and alerts the nearby Muramites that rush to ambush you!

Swinging her weapon one last time, the massive entity falls to her side with a thud. While she was a creature consumed with destruction, her death is still graceful. As her bloodstained braids come to a rest on the floor and her muscles relax, you can't help but wonder what could make such a magnificent creature so deadly.
cries out in failure, scrambling for the treasure as it crumbles to ash.
You are not welcome in Tunares sacred lands!
How dare you violate this sacred place, you shall rot!
Die!
You have some nerve!
shouts in a shrill voice as it lunges to attack, 'Defeat the invaders!  They seek to invade our lair!'
rushes forward as dirt sprays off its limbs.
Grrrreeeoww!!!  I shall gut you like a fish for your vile ways!!
growls fiercely, saliva foaming around its ferocious, jagged maw, 'This is our home now!  Begone, or the legions of TomEar shall slay you all'
Bbbaarrrrkkk!!!  Another intruder has fallen at the hands of the TomEar.  Who is next to fall?  HHhhooooowwwLLLL!!!
The might of the oceans is at my command, and with it I shall end your existence, strange one!!
The might of the oceans is at my command, and with it I shall end your existence, strange one!!
You have met your match!!
My comrades will avenge my death.
Ugly creature near my feet, me thinks that you'll be good to eat!
screeches shrilly as it swoops in to attack.
Aaargh!!  The picks of Mining Guild 628 shall avenge my death.
Your name has been stricken from the book of the Prime Healer!!  I shall be avenged!
Your act of murder will not go unnoticed by the Unkempt Druids or nature itself!!
You fool!!  My brothers and sisters of the Wolves of the North shall hunt you down!  You.. are.. through..
My comrades will avenge my death.
My comrades will avenge my death.
Spirits and elders, guide my hand.  This tasty fool has invaded our land!
Click...whir...whir...click!
I shall turn you inside out!!
Glad to meet you. Our Cargo Clockwork is marvelous, no?
I will destroy all outlanders for the master!
Oh great Veeshan, give this worn shell strength, for I do battle this day in your name!
Of dragon kin I come at thee, now is time for you to flee!
My comrades will avenge my death.
falls from the air and lies limply on the ground.
jumps to attack the intruder.
moans in agony as it clutches at the mortal wounds it has received.
charges in to attack.
falls lifelessly to the ground...
clicks its mandibles and advances.
Cease and desist!!
Mind your business!!
hisses, baring its fangs.  It has very sharp fangs, for an overgrown mushroom!
hoots, grunts, and snarls.
My comrades will avenge my death.
emits a high pitched wail, ichor oozing from its battered carapace.
I have nothing left to lose.  Can you say the same?
Fear the blades of the Iksar!!
shrivels up, its life ebbing.
That's it, now you die!
Damn, that was fast!
This is not good.
Take it outside!
I have better things to do with my time.
Oh, so that is how it is going to be then?  Fine.
